description: WINDOWS ONLY (build.rs). Tauri on Windows treats only http://<protocol>.localhost as the app's own origin; a per-document origin http://bento.<24 hex>.localhost is 'remote' and is refused every custom command unless a remote capability says otherwise (measured on WebView2). This admits exactly bento_arm and bento_file to exactly those origins. Both still demand the load's capability secret, which stays the rule: this file is a second layer, never the boundary. No core or plugin permission is granted, and no bento_id: nothing on Windows can use it until a key store exists. release-check asserts this file and these commands are all that ship.
